environment: Node.js full application VM with recording draw context and real scene pointer handlers
limitations: Not browser layout, native pointer input, canvas rasterization or native Save As QA.

results.name: A nonzero frame origin aligns opaque source pixels to entity feet
Facing left reflects each pixel around feet without a one-pixel shift
Preview uses source-scene sprite palette instead of room palette
Per-piece palette and horizontal flip remain effective
Saved default state selects its first frame independently of editor preview state
An unavailable default animation can use the existing idle binding
Fully transparent art retains a selectable marker
A missing source scene retains the marker and does not throw
Partially missing tile assets use a marker rather than an incomplete character
Drawing includes real scaled pixels and no old marker beneath a bound actor
Selected configured player movement body ends exactly at feet height
Unselected actors do not show a movement-body overlay
Other player entities do not inherit the configured collision body
Viewer mode keeps authored actor art but has no gameplay body
Changing active scene does not reuse another room player body
The visible art can be selected above the old centered marker
Selection follows reflected geometry instead of the right-facing pose
Selected player body is draggable with exclusive floor/right boundaries
Overlapping actors keep the highest entity-index selection priority
Mixed scenes preserve legacy marker size, icon, and selection index
Unbound viewer actors retain the original marker drawing and hit regions
A configured player with unavailable art still shows body and feet
8 by 16 vertical flips swap the two tiles around the frame origin
Source pixels and palette edits take effect immediately without saving a scene
Numeric entity coordinates move the whole pose while retaining the anchor
Existing canvas drag handler grabs visible art and preserves feet offset
Scene placement preview does not mutate saved data, animation playback, or undo history
Placement module and handlers report no unexpected application errors
